metadata.description: CairnGo — Claude Code plugins by FelipeOFF

plugins.name: cairn
plugins.description: Cairn — marks the trail and remembers the path. Batteries-included: installing it pulls in GSD (a plugin dependency) and bootstraps the beads issue tracker (bd); a single /cairn:init wires a project end to end and installs the cairn GSD capability, fusing the two loops so plain /gsd:* commands create, claim, close, and gate bd issues invisibly, while /cairn:migrate wires repos that already have .planning/ or .beads/ history. Optionally mirrors bd issues two-way (hub-and-spoke) to GitHub Issues, GitLab, Jira, Asana, and Azure Boards, and optionally makes the context-mode knowledge base intent-aware (scopes compressed memory to the active issue + phase). The integration conventions activate only in repos that use both GSD and beads.

plugins.name: gsd-core
plugins.description: GSD Core — the official Get Shit Done: a structured planning/execution/verification workflow for Claude Code (/gsd:*), MCP-backed project state, and the capability system cairn plugs into. Published in this marketplace as a dependency of cairn so it installs automatically, sourced from upstream open-gsd/gsd-core and pinned to a release tag rather than tracking the default branch (which is the development branch 'next'). Compatibility is declared by the cairn capability's engines.gsd range (>=1.8.0). Installable on its own too.
